name: Najlaa Abuouda
heroText: UX/UI designer for mobile and web products. I build design systems with clear documentation in Figma, and design with Claude, from first screens to custom skills that speed up the work.
about: I'm Najlaa Abuouda, a UX/UI designer who has been designing mobile apps and websites since 2019. I care about more than how a screen looks: I want it to solve a real problem for the person using it.

I have designed and redesigned more than 15 apps and websites: online stores with customer, seller and driver roles, delivery, hospital and legal apps, landing pages and a SaaS platform. I start with user research, personas, journeys and flows, then move to wireframes, prototypes and polished, responsive UI. I work closely with developers, test the experience before launch, and can turn designs into HTML, CSS and Bootstrap when the project needs it.

experience.text: Intuitive, responsive products for clients, including a scalable SaaS platform. User journeys, personas and flows, prototypes and mockups, UI turned into HTML, CSS and Bootstrap, and testing before apps go live on the stores.
Wireframes for mobile and web, Marvel prototypes, and redesigns of 5 mobile apps to make them easier to use. Designed 7 mobile apps with their web designs, plus App Store and Google Play screenshots.
Redesigned hospital, legal and delivery apps. Designed an online store app with customer, seller and driver roles, landing pages for a delivery app, and three apps and four websites in total.
Wireframes and prototypes for mobile apps, alongside brand work such as business cards and social media posts.
